summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed an 8-K announcing its board approved a regular quarterly dividend of $0.484375 per share on its 7.75% Series A Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a record date of June 20, 2026 and payment date of June 30, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is involved. The filing simply provides notice of the dividend, which is a standard ongoing obligation for the preferred shares.
